info.name: Get Interactions based on filter criteria

params.name: DateReference
params.description: Specifies whether to filter by 'InteractionDate' or 'ArrivalDate'.

params.name: StartDate
params.description: The start date for filtering interactions. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

params.name: EndDate
params.description: The end date for filtering interactions. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.

params.name: Status
params.description: The status filter for interactions. Valid values: 'Sampled', 'ReadyToSample'.

params.name: EddyEffect
params.description: Boolean filter for the Eddy Effect model results. Valid values: 'true', 'false'.

params.name: LastId
params.description: The last Interaction ID (excluded) to start pagination from.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: The number of results to return per call. Must be an integer between 1 and 20.
